cards.title: Main Bearings and Connecting Rod Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during every M54 rebuild.

cards.title: Complete Gasket and Seal Set
cards.body: All gaskets and seals are replaced as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Timing Chain Components
cards.body: Timing chain components are replaced where required during the rebuild.

cards.title: Crankshaft
cards.body: The crankshaft is inspected and measured to ensure it meets OEM tolerances.
